1: // Simple Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const w = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth);
8:   const h = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight);
9: 
10:   const center = { x: w / 2, y: h / 2 };
11:   const planet = { r: 30 };
12:   const ship = {
13:     angle: 0,
14:     radius: 120,
15:     innerRadius: 80,
16:     outerRadius: 140,
17:     size: 8,
18:     speed: 0.02,
19:   };
20:   const asteroids = [];
21:   let lastSpawn = 0;
22:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
23:   let gameOver = false;
24: 
25:   function spawnAsteroid() {
26:     // Choose random edge
27:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
28:     let x, y, vx, vy;
29:     const speed = 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.5;
30:     if (side === 0) {
31:       // top
32:       x = Math.random() * w;
33:       y = -10;
34:     } else if (side === 1) {
35:       // right
36:       x = w + 10;
37:       y = Math.random() * h;
38:     } else if (side === 2) {
39:       // bottom
40:       x = Math.random() * w;
41:       y = h + 10;
42:     } else {
43:       // left
44:       x = -10;
45:       y = Math.random() * h;
46:     }
47:     // Vector towards center
48:     const dx = center.x - x;
49:     const dy = center.y - y;
50:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
51:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
52:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
53:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 6 });
54:   }
55: 
56:   function update(dt) {
57:     if (gameOver) return;
58:     // Ship orbit
59:     ship.angle += ship.speed * dt;
60:     // Toggle radius on input handled elsewhere
61:     // Update asteroids
62:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
63:       const a = asteroids[i];
64:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
65:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
66:       // Remove if near center
67:       if (Math.hypot(a.x - center.x, a.y - center.y) < planet.r) {
68:         gameOver = true;
69:         return;
70:       }
71:       // Collision with ship
72:       const shipPos = {
73:         x: center.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
74:         y: center.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
75:       };
76:       if (Math.hypot(a.x - shipPos.x, a.y - shipPos.y) < a.r + ship.size) {
77:         gameOver = true;
78:         return;
79:       }
80:     }
81:     // Spawn new asteroid
82:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
83:       spawnAsteroid();
84:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
85:     }
86:   }
87: 
88:   function draw() {
89:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
90:     // Planet
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3b4b';
92:     ctx.beginPath();
93:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
94:     ctx.fill();
95:     // Ship
96:     const shipPos = {
97:       x: center.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
98:       y: center.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
99:     };
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
101:     ctx.beginPath();
102:     ctx.arc(shipPos.x, shipPos.y, ship.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
103:     ctx.fill();
104:     // Asteroids
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
106:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
107:       ctx.beginPath();
108:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
109:       ctx.fill();
110:     });
111:     if (gameOver) {
112:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
113:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
114:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
115:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
116:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
117:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   let lastTime = performance.now();
122:   function loop() {
123:     const now = performance.now();
124:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps steps
125:     lastTime = now;
126:     update(dt);
127:     draw();
128:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
129:   }
130: 
131:   // Input: space or click toggles between inner and outer orbit radius
132:   function toggleRadius() {
133:     ship.radius = ship.radius === ship.innerRadius ? ship.outerRadius : ship.innerRadius;
134:   }
135:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
136:     if (e.code === 'Space') toggleRadius();
137:   });
138:   canvas.addEventListener('click', toggleRadius);
139: 
140:   // Start
141:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142: })();
